The label distribution incorporation step then integrates the estimated label information into the GNN training process, using a modified loss function that takes into account the estimated pseudo-labels. Finally, the method optimizes the GNN parameters using a standard optimization procedure. The authors evaluate their framework on several benchmark attributed graphs, including Cora, Citeseer, Pubmed, Wiki, CS, and Photo, demonstrating significant improvements over baseline GNN models, particularly when the number of labeled nodes is extremely small.
